{{Quote|It's all about the credits, right? Why else do any of us do this?|Dindo|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Dindo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] bodyguard who was active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I knew I'd regret...this stupid job....|Dindo's final words|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Dindo traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when he was hired by [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]] to protect him. However, Dindo saw this job very futile since Lokai left him to die on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] arrived to kill Lokai, Dindo was forced to engage the bounty hunter, but was easily defeated. Dindo immediately gave up the fight and the hunter told everything about Lokai. He begged the hunter to let him go since it was not personal for him to die, but the hunter did not buy his plea, and shot him.<ref name="TOR" />
